August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 161)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American network radio, Vincent Price starring as Simon Templar in The Saint, two witty Mr. and Mrs. North murder investigations (Alice Frost for Woodbury Soap and Barbara Britton for Colgate Dental Cream), William L. Shirer and Bob Trout on CBS European News reporting the first RAF bombing raid on Berlin, Charlotte Greenwood welcoming returning GIs for Hallmark Cards, and Douglas Edwards (1940–1952):
